notes: 🤖 GlowBot: /calc does sums with units, like /calc 1 in to mm. The bot works it out itself, without an AI model
The owner gets a private desk in the bot: /note, /notes, /save, /links, /post, /posts and /export keep notes, links and approved posts
The Guard checks everything before it is kept and refuses passwords, keys, tokens and the words on the owner's own list (/guard, /scan)
/brief shows the last pushes on GitHub. The desk answers only the owner, in the owner's private chat
